scope: Guild-prefix validation and confirmed persistence shared between text, slash and web; global prefix and full reset traced as separate legacy intents

verification.storage: Real SyncMap and setup-settings CAS over synthetic model; no real database
verification.handler: Actual dashboard POST handler extracted from source AST

changes: Shared 1–5 UTF-16 unit validator; reject whitespace/control/format characters without truncation
Existing setup-settings queue, conditional update, no-op and shutdown behavior reused
Same Discord orchestration, fresh Administrator/channel/bot checks before save
Web prefix form owns only its field/revision/CSRF; rejects old mixed or unversioned writes
Messages es/en; existing fallback for other languages
limitations: Global owner configuration and full reset recorded without execution or migration
No durable cross-transport operation receipt; stale replay must reread revision
